com.legacycolonies.building.builder_post: Where the colony builder works. Placed above the colony hearth.
com.legacycolonies.building.colony_campf: Founds the colony and marks its centre.
com.legacycolonies.building.forge.desc: Where the player works metal, with a TFC forge and an anvil.
com.legacycolonies.building.granary.desc: Food of the citizens: from the iron age, each one takes a ration every day from its food shelves and hangers. It must be a Firmalife cellar.
com.legacycolonies.building.house.desc: Home of the citizens: one citizen per bed.
com.legacycolonies.building.inn.desc: Shelter for citizens without a house. Takes no visitors.
com.legacycolonies.building.school.desc: Teaching of the heir: each level lets the player make one change to the traits of their heir, add a trait or drop one of theirs ("Heir" button).
com.legacycolonies.building.stable.desc: Shelter for animals of any kind. No worker.
com.legacycolonies.building.warehouse.de: Chests and barrels of the colony. No courier.
com.legacycolonies.confirm.builder_built: This hut was given to the builder: its levels come from the builder, not from "Confirm building".
com.legacycolonies.confirm.max_level: This hut is already at its highest level.
com.legacycolonies.confirm.no_colony: This hut does not belong to a colony.
com.legacycolonies.confirm.no_permission: You are not allowed to manage the huts of this colony.
com.legacycolonies.confirm.no_rules: Level %s of this hut cannot be built by hand: ask the builder.
com.legacycolonies.confirm.not_closed: The room around the hut is not closed: there is an opening to the outside.
com.legacycolonies.confirm.not_covered: The hut is not under a roof: place it inside the building.
com.legacycolonies.confirm.too_big: The room around the hut is too big (more than %s air blocks) or not closed.
com.legacycolonies.confirm.work_order: This hut has a work order in progress: cancel it or wait until it is done.
com.legacycolonies.hearth.in_colony: This firepit is already inside a colony.
com.legacycolonies.material_pile.complet: Work order "%s": the material pile is complete, the builder starts.
com.legacycolonies.material_pile.more: The work order needs %s × %s more than listed: add them to the material pile at %s %s %s.
com.legacycolonies.material_pile.placed: Work order "%s": the builder waits for its materials on the material pile at %s %s %s. Right click the pile to see what is missing.
com.legacycolonies.mode.hand_built: This hut was built by hand: the builder does not build, upgrade or repair it. Use "Confirm building" for its next level.
com.legacycolonies.needs.arrived: %s arrives at the colony and settles in.
com.legacycolonies.needs.era_changed: The colony enters %s: up to %s citizens.
com.legacycolonies.needs.food.unfed: %s citizen(s) had no ration today: put food that is not rotten on the food shelves or hangers of the granary.
com.legacycolonies.needs.level_too_high: %s level %s is out of reach in %s (level %s at most).
com.legacycolonies.needs.status.food: Rations in the working cellars of the granaries: %s (granaries: %s)
com.legacycolonies.needs.status.food_unl: Rations: a granary is too far to be counted.
com.legacycolonies.needs.status.full_era: No new citizen: the colony is as big as its age allows.
com.legacycolonies.needs.status.need_bed: No new citizen: every bed is taken. Build a bed in the inn or a house.
com.legacycolonies.needs.status.need_foo: No new citizen: the granaries cannot feed one more tomorrow.
com.legacycolonies.needs.status.no_colon: You are not in a colony and do not own one.
com.legacycolonies.needs.status.title: Colony %s, %s
com.legacycolonies.needs.status.unfed: No new citizen: %s citizen(s) had no ration today.
com.legacycolonies.needs.too_many: In %s, the colony may have %s × %s at most.
com.legacycolonies.plan.missing: There is no plan for %s level %s in the %s pack: the builder cannot build it.
com.legacycolonies.school.plan: The heir will have: %s. Will not have: %s. The other traits are inherited as usual.
com.legacycolonies.school.plan.none: No change: the heir inherits as usual.
com.legacycolonies.school.summary: School level %s: %s of %s change(s) made. The heir has at most %s traits: drop one before adding one to a full character.
com.legacycolonies.school.title: Heir of %s
com.legacycolonies.school.unmarried: Only a married character has an heir.
